title: Budget Freeze - Price Objection Despite Interest

customer_profile.name: Ananya Kapoor
customer_profile.opening_message: This looks good, but we’re in a budget freeze until next quarter.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent respects the freeze, clarifies timeline/approval path, and sets a concrete plan with a scheduled follow-up date
customer_profile.personality_notes: Interested in moving forward but limited by fiscal constraints; wants a clear plan rather than pressure.

checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Validate the freeze and keep tone supportive, not salesy.

checkpoints.description: Clarify timeline and approval path (end date, approver, exceptions if any)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask when it lifts and who signs off; check if exceptions exist.

checkpoints.description: Confirm priority and cost of delay in the customer’s terms
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask what waiting costs them (delays, manual work, risk).

checkpoints.description: Offer 2-3 low-commitment next steps to keep momentum
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Suggest security review, pilot scope, ROI worksheet, stakeholder alignment.

checkpoints.description: Schedule a specific follow-up date and summarize actions/owners
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: End with a calendar commitment and short action plan.

scenario_context: Prospect is interested but blocked by a budget freeze. Must validate constraint, clarify timeline and approval path, propose low-commitment next steps, and schedule a follow-up date. Avoid pressure and early discounting.
success_summary: Successfully demonstrate: Objection Handling + Next-Step Planning
